_help.functional: Independent correctness review: requirements, boundaries, API compatibility, and regressions. Prefer strong code comprehension in your project language. All roles benefit from reliable MCP tools and clear structured reviews, with approved data handling and acceptable cost.
_help.risk: Independent risk review: failures, retries, concurrency, authorization, and data consistency. Prefer evidence-based cross-path reasoning and reliable tool use. Also handles source checks and comments for this mode; standalone /pr-check uses review.risk.
_help.verifier: Verify both initial reviews against source, find counterevidence, merge duplicates, and produce the final report. Prefer strong evidence judgment, long-context handling, and instruction following. Never just summarize or vote. Roles may reuse the same model ID.
